rationale: C09 supplies the concrete regulatory rule that the child expressly endorses: agricultural registrants producing substantial quantities of commodities for market may receive occupational deferment, subject to general necessary-employment criteria. The child closely reuses that language and administrative framework while discussing implementation through farm-productivity ratings. C12 is a strong antecedent containing substantially the same Class II-C rule, while C06 restates the broader selective-service classification machinery, but C09 is the closest and most recent textual template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: classifying in a deferred class registrants whose activities are necessary to the maintenance of the production of substantial quantities of agricultural commodities for market
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In Class II-C shall be placed any registrant who is employed in the production for market of a substantial quantity of those agricultural commodities which are necessary to the maintenance of the national health, safety, or interest
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive overlap in the agricultural-deferment rule: deferred classification, production for market, substantial quantities of agricultural commodities, and necessity to the national interest.

shared_material.child_excerpt: who meet the other criteria of your regulations for deferment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: but only when all of the conditions described in paragraph (a) of § 1622.10 are found to exist
shared_material.explanation: Both make agricultural deferment conditional on satisfying additional regulatory criteria rather than treating farm employment alone as sufficient.

shared_material.child_excerpt: consistent with adherence to the policy of universal liability for service for all men between the ages of 18½ and 26
shared_material.parent_excerpt: A registrant's employment... shall be considered to be necessary... only when all of the following conditions exist
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward C09's structural balance between general military liability and narrowly conditioned occupational deferment.
